entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Uh, hi. I think... I think I need to return something? I'm not really sure how this works.
I can certainly help you with a return. To start, could you tell me which product you're calling about?
It's the Trail Helmet. I got it a few weeks ago. The box is still unopened. I'm just so confused by the website.
Okay, the Trail Helmet. Not a problem. To understand the situation better, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
Oh, I... I don't think it's broken. It's just the color. It looked different online and I just... I don't like it. I don't know what to do. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can help. I understand that sometimes the color can be a surprise. Let me just pull up our return policy for you. One moment.
Alright, I've checked our system. For an item like this helmet, our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery, as long as it's in its original condition.
Ninety days? Oh. So it's okay then? I can send it back?

Yes, absolutely. You are well within that timeframe. Your safety and satisfaction are our top priorities, so we want to make sure you have the right gear. I'm processing the return for you right now and will email you a prepaid shipping label.
Wow, okay. That's a huge relief. Thank you so much, Alex.
You are very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was it. Thank you.
Great. Have a wonderful day, and thank you for choosing VeloFit.
